about: Who writes what in the phi-web-assets bucket. Each prefix has one writer; a writer never touches another's keys. Uploaded as index.json at the bucket root by webui scripts/r2-upload.mjs. Rendered cards live in the private bucket phi-web-cache, not here.

writers.phi-unpackd: Rust ripper (ill-sync-worker) on the assets machine. Runs by itself when TapTap ships a new version: lists R2, uploads only files whose size and MD5 differ, and removes keys it no longer produces under the prefixes it alone owns.
writers.ill-sync: Cloudflare Worker (ill-sync), cron. Mirrors phi-plugin's GitHub resources and community aliases; prunes only its own directories and refuses protected prefixes.
writers.phi-specials: Rust tool (ill-sync-worker-special), run by hand on the assets machine for anything that needs song, key or text knowledge.
writers.pv-overlay: Render pipeline (pv-overlay folder), run by hand; upload.sh sends its output.
writers.story-timeline: Limbo Wiki crawl and reading pipeline (story-timeline folder), run by hand; publish.sh checks the data and sends it with webui scripts/r2-upload.mjs.
writers.webui-scripts: webui scripts/publish-*.ts, run by hand; built on any machine and sent with scripts/r2-upload.mjs, every index.json last.

caching.about: Cache Rules on the phibot.dev zone.

rules.why: change only when the game updates

rules.match: 4-1/, removed/, history/, info/oldInfo/, c9s6/, deduction/, collection-art/, texts/images/, pv/video/, pv/overlay/, pv/special/
rules.why: archives and story art that never change

rules.match: info/ (but oldInfo/), tips/, _sync/, collection/, texts/*.json, web-cards/, every index.json and specials.json, original_ill/levels.json; only without ?v
rules.why: data that changes in place; the site reads these through the API

caching.errors: 4xx stay at the edge 60s, 5xx are never kept. A Response Header Transform Rule on each zone ("R2 errors: no browser cache", http.response.code ge 400) sends Cache-Control: no-store to browsers
caching.purge: Nothing purges after a game update: unversioned game files can be up to 30 days old at the edge. The zone token has no Cache Purge permission
